pages.text: White morning mist lay thick. Dad had already gone to work at the weir upstream, where water rushed over.
Mom wrapped warm bread in a cloth. "I'll take it to Dad!" Mumu offered.
Dodo led the way. "I know paths in the mist! Follow me!"
They walked into the white mist. Even one step ahead was hazy.
A big willow appeared. Dodo bumped into a branch, leaving one feather caught on it. "This tree... I haven't seen it before."
A little farther on was another big willow. On its branch was that same feather. They had gone in a circle.
Dodo's eyes widened. "The tree... is following us!"
Mumu listened closely. Somewhere, water was rushing.
They followed the sound. Through the mist came the weir. Dad waved a wing.
"Dad, breakfast!" The bread was still warm. Just then, the mist cleared. The mill was right there, close before them. Dad took a big bite.
